name: MCP Measurement Test Board - Scenario 2 (100 x 50 mm)
notes: From TestData/Scenario2 (Fusion 360 PCB.fbrd / Schematic.fsch, 18/11/26). Circuit: R3/C1 RC low-pass into an LM741 inverting amplifier (R1 input, R2 feedback, +IN to GND); supply +/-V on JP1. Board frame: origin = lower-left corner of the PCB on its top surface, X along the 100 mm edge, Y along the 50 mm edge, Z up. Test point X/Y are exact from the board file. NOT YET TAUGHT: board_frame origin/rotation are placeholders copied from example_board, and z_mm = 8.5 assumes standard 2.54 mm single header pins (2.5 mm plastic + 6 mm pin). Teach the frame and measure the pin height with robot_teach before probing the real board. Clearance 30 mm clears C1 (radial, 12.5 mm tall). Keep the scope probe ground clipped to GND (TP6 or J3/J2 pin 1).

test_points.description: Circuit input from J3 pin 2, before R3
